items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee states that 'Jimmy' is a nickname for himself ('most of my friends called me James or Jim, you know, Jimmy').

ctx.x: He used to call me James. You know, most of them down there call me that. James O. My father called me James O. My mother did. Most of my friends called me James or Jim, you know, Jimmy. But I didn't get that name "Trummy" until later years around Washington. And this guy Booker Coleman named me that.

But how we got that name is he couldn't remember names. So, he called the bass player Bassie, and he called the drummer Drumski, and he called me Trummy. And just my name just stuck. That Trummy just stuck. But he'd call everybody, you know, Trumpski -- the trumpet player -- that's because he couldn't remember names. It wasn't because he was trying to give me any name. But that name just stuck on me, you know.
